title: Families begin bringing home remains of MV June Aster fire victims

blocks.text: Emotional scenes unfolded at Coron port as sealed boxes containing the remains of victims identified in the deadly fire aboard the passenger vessel MV June Aster were loaded onto ships for transport to their hometowns, more than a month after the tragedy.
